blocks.title: Zware regen, harde wind
blocks.text: Het Nederlands zegt harde wind, zware regen en druk verkeer. Het Engels: strong wind, heavy rain, heavy traffic. Letterlijk vertalen (hard wind, busy traffic) klinkt onnatuurlijk.
Sommige woordparen hebben een vaste volgorde, die je niet kunt omdraaien: pros and cons, nooit cons and pros.

blocks.title: Leer ze als één blok
blocks.text: Omdraaien klinkt fout, ook als het Nederlands een ander paar gebruikt: heen en weer = back and forth, rust en vrede = peace and quiet, min of meer = more or less.

rows: It doesn't make sense to take a decision now.
It doesn't make sense to make a decision now.
Beide kan; make a decision is gewoner.
We should take in account the cost.
We should take the cost into account.
I'm tired and sick of it.
I'm sick and tired of it.

blocks.text: Vul het ontbrekende woord in. De antwoorden staan op de laatste pagina.

items.q: We were stuck in ______ traffic for an hour.
items.full: We were stuck in heavy traffic for an hour.

items.q: She speaks English with a ______ French accent.
items.full: She speaks English with a strong French accent.

items.q: It is highly ______ that he will win.
items.full: It is highly unlikely that he will win.

items.q: I was bitterly ______ with the result.
items.full: I was bitterly disappointed with the result.

items.q: You should ______ advantage of this offer.
items.full: You should take advantage of this offer.
A holiday would do you good.

items.q: Let's weigh up the pros and ______.
items.full: Let's weigh up the pros and cons.

items.q: The children came home safe and ______.
items.full: The children came home safe and sound.
I'm sick and tired of waiting.
We learnt by trial and error.

items.q: Two people were ______ injured in the crash.
items.full: Two people were seriously injured in the crash.

items.q: Vroeg of laat komt hij erachter.
items.a: Sooner or later he will find out.

items.q: Je moet rekening houden met de kosten.
items.a: You have to take the costs into account.
